name: defra-adts
description: ADTS cross-service test tooling and E2E suite
author: ADTS-Defra

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix services/adts-ui && npm install --prefix services/adts-submissions-service && npm install --prefix services/adts-backend
scripts.dev: npm run test:db:up && concurrently -k -n BACKEND,UI,SUBMISSIONS -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:submissions"
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000 AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local PORT=3200 npm start --prefix services/adts-backend
scripts.dev:ui: cross-env NODE_ENV=development SESSION_SECRET=local-development-session-secret-32-chars BACKEND_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:3200 PORT=3000 npm start --prefix services/adts-ui
scripts.dev:submissions: cross-env PORT=3100 LIMS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3300 npm start --prefix services/adts-submissions-service
scripts.dev:down: lsof -tiTCP:3000,3100,3200 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; npm run test:db:down
scripts.test:services: npm run test:ui && npm run test:submissions && npm run test:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:services && npm run test:e2e
